title: Tropical Rainbow Blast Geek Bar Pulse 15000 puffs
description:
Tropical Rainbow Blast Geek Bar Pulse Disposable Vape
The ultimate in luxury, the Tropical Rainbow Blast Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape provides a remarkable vaping experience. With its delicious Tropical Rainbow Blast flavor and remarkable 15000 puff capacity, this disposable vape pen captures the spirit of a trip with every draw. Rich clouds of delicious fruit sensations are delivered by the inventive design, which guarantees a smooth draw.
Multiple Perks
Whether you’re looking for a moment of calm or an escape from the everyday, this vaporizer is certain to take you to a vibrant, fruity paradise filled with pure pleasure. With the elegance and ease of use of the Tropical Rainbow Blast Geek Bar Pulse 15000, you may enhance your vaping experience.
The profile of Tropical Rainbow Blast Flavor
Disposable Tropical Rainbow Blast Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Vape presents a magnificent blend of exotic fruits that creates a symphony of tropical sensations. With every sniff, this flawless infusion captures the cool, dreamy charm of a tropical paradise with the ideal ratio of sweet to sour. You can anticipate a smooth fusion of juicy fruits with each puff, creating a mouthwatering rainbow of tastes that dance over your tongue. Savor the revitalizing flavors of juicy mangoes, sweet pineapples, and zesty citrus, which combine to provide an intensely satisfying vaping experience.
Additional Features:
Battery Capacity: 650 mAh
E-Liquid Capacity: 16 mL
Nicotine Strength: 50 mg
Puff Count: 15,000 in standard mode, 7,500 in pulse mode
Modes: Standard and Pulse
Charging: USB-C port
FAQ
What sets the Tropical Rainbow Blast flavor apart from other vape flavors?
The Tropical Rainbow Blast flavor offers a unique blend of juicy mangoes, sweet pineapples, and zesty citrus, creating a refreshing and tropical vaping experience unlike any other.
Can I adjust the power settings on the Geek Bar Pulse Tropical Rainbow Blast?
Yes, the device features both standard and pulse modes, allowing you to adjust the power settings to suit your vaping preferences.
What is the e-liquid capacity of the Tropical Rainbow Blast Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
It comes preloaded with a generous 16mL e-liquid capacity, ensuring you have plenty of vape juice for extended vaping sessions.
Can I refill the e-liquid in the Geek Bar Pulse Tropical Rainbow Blast?
No, the device is disposable and comes pre-filled with e-liquid, eliminating the need for refilling.
